integrity: The continuous boundary-ratio and minimax calculations are proved analytically; a separately replayable finite boundary sample is illustrative only. No independent validation or independent audit has occurred.
limitations: The theorem addresses two elementary degree-one Blaschke factors with interior zeros and complex scalars. It does not classify higher-degree Blaschke pairs or general inner functions. Existing qualitative Birkhoff--James characterizations remain prior work. A differently formulated published equivalent may exist.
title: Exact two-generator norms of elementary Blaschke factors
